name: How can I ensure my family room addition is energy efficient?

mainEntity.name: How can I ensure my family room addition is energy efficient?

acceptedAnswer.text: To ensure your family room addition is energy efficient, focus on high-performance insulation for walls, roof, and floor, install energy-efficient windows and doors, and properly seal all air gaps to prevent drafts. Consider integrating a separate HVAC zone for the new space or upgrading your existing system to accommodate the increased load. These choices will help reduce long-term energy consumption and contribute to comfortable indoor temperatures. For projects in areas like Emeryville or San Leandro, meeting California's stringent energy codes is a primary consideration.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ensure energy efficiency with high-performance insulation, energy-efficient windows and doors, proper sealing, and considering HVAC zoning.
